cn.t: Critics are split on Roundabout's revival of Priestley's dated 1937 drama—Charlotte Parry earns consistent praise, but uneven direction and mixed accents divide opinion. The play's time-bending structure intrigues more than it satisfies.

vs.sum: Completed a major renovation in early 2026 with all seats replaced and legroom expanded, making it one of Broadway's most comfortable and modern houses. New restrooms significantly reduce intermission wait times.
